content: Modules are cached in sys.modules so module-level mutable objects are process-wide singletons that persist across repeated library calls. Consequences: leaked state between calls, non-reentrant behaviour, test contamination, concurrency bugs. Preferred fix is passing a per-call context/state object and returning results; if a global must stay, expose an explicit reset API and document the lifecycle. importlib.reload is not a reliable escape hatch because old references survive.
